title: DCP Cyclic-Subgroup Quotient-Aliasing Audit: g-Fold Coset Indistinguishability, Euler-Ramanujan Divisor-Stratum Sum, and Folded-Kernel Parseval Identity

theorems.name: Exact Coset Periodicity and Folded Visibility Identity
theorems.statement: For any difference d in {1, ..., q-1} with g = gcd(d, q), m = q/g, and d' = d/g, rho_d((s + k*m) mod q; K_eta) = rho_d(s; K_eta) for all k in {0, ..., g-1}, and lambda_d(K_eta) = lambda_(d')(K_eta^(m)) where K_eta^(m)(e_bar) = sum_(k=0)^(g-1) K_eta(e_bar + k*m).

theorems.name: Exact Divisor-Stratum Cardinality and Ramanujan-Sum Visibility Total
theorems.statement: The divisor strata D_g(q) = {d in {1, ..., q-1} : gcd(d, q) = g} have cardinality |D_g(q)| = phi(q/g) summing to q - 1, and sum_(d in D_g(q)) lambda_d(K_eta) = sum_(e=0)^(q-1) K_eta(e) c_(q/g)(e) where c_m(e) is Ramanujan's sum.

theorems.name: Subgroup Parseval Identity and Monotone Purity Under Folding
theorems.statement: For every divisor g | q with m = q/g, the folded kernel purity satisfies ||K_eta^(m)||_2^2 = sum_(e_bar=0)^(m-1) K_eta^(m)(e_bar)^2 = (g/q) * sum_(k=0)^(m-1) lambda_(k*g)(K_eta)^2 >= ||K_eta||_2^2.
